name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-12-05, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
